Concept

Nordbahn Fundbüro

Lost on the train, while you are still on it

Open sbbfundbuero.orangecat.ch → Source

Report a lost item bound to the real journey from Swiss open transport data, so staff can look while the train is still moving. Items reported within thirty minutes are mostly recovered; after a day, mostly not. A concept on mock data — not affiliated with SBB, built to show them.

The image is a screenshot of sbbfundbuero.orangecat.ch, taken by a machine when this site was built. If the product changed, so did the picture.
